Migration.title: Chornohora — Four Skies
Migration.notice: The original v22 animated journey is being migrated to Next.js. This page is a technical foundation, not the finished landing page.

Journey.heroTagline: One journey. Four moments to remember forever.
Journey.heroHeading: A day on the ridge: from sunrise to stars
Journey.heroDescription: A guided trek along Ukraine's Chornohora ridge. Sunrise on Hoverla, lunch by an alpine lake, sunset and a starry night on Petros. A small group and an experienced guide.
Journey.subtitle2: A lake that holds the sky
Journey.subtitle3: An evening ablaze on the water
Journey.lead1: Ukraine's highest summit. We set out before dawn to meet the sunrise at the top.
Journey.lead2: The country's highest-altitude lake. Cold water, silence and lunch on the rocks.
Journey.lead3: A glacial lake cradled by the mountains. The sky burns and the water mirrors its colors.
Journey.lead4: A tent on the meadow, far from city lights. Only stars overhead.
Journey.card11Text: The trail begins near Zarosliak outside Vorokhta. The ascent takes several hours.
Journey.card12Text: On a clear day you can see the entire Chornohora ridge.
Journey.card13Text: Bring warm layers: the summit is windy even in summer.
Journey.card21Text: Nestled below the namesake peak, among boulders and alpine meadows.
Journey.card22Text: We pause for lunch and a longer rest.
Journey.card23Text: Very cold even in summer — swimming is only for the brave.
Journey.card31Text: The lake sits in an ancient glacial hollow.
Journey.card32Text: The light changes every minute, so we stop to take it in.
Journey.card33Text: When the wind stops, the water becomes a mirror.
Journey.card41Text: One of the highest peaks in the Chornohora range.
Journey.card42Text: Far from city lights, the Milky Way is clearly visible.
Journey.card43Text: It gets cold even in summer, so a warm sleeping bag is essential.
Journey.finalDescription: Head out with the sun. The group is small and places are limited.
Journey.footerTagline: One journey. Four moments to remember forever.
